title: anthemis cretica subsp. umbilicata
intro: Anthemis cretica subsp. umbilicata, commonly known as a type of daisy or yarrow, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Anthemis cretica subsp. umbilicata include analgesic, antipyretic, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating pain, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as camphor, borneol, and thujone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
